packs.name: Meadow
packs.blurb: Open grass everywhere underfoot. Walk the whole meadow without leaving a blade untouched.

packs.name: Creek
packs.blurb: A streambed of golden stones, slick till you've stood on them twice, and one washed clean through.

packs.name: Gully
packs.blurb: Steel grey scree that only lets go after three footfalls.

packs.name: Outcrop
packs.blurb: Weathered rock, part gold veined, part steel grey, exposed side by side.

packs.name: Billabong
packs.blurb: Still water that only drains one way, however it pooled in.

packs.name: Ridge
packs.blurb: A spine of rock that turns from gold to steel grey as you walk it, always leading on in a single direction.

packs.name: Mesa
packs.blurb: Sheer on every side but one; the only way up is the one true face.

packs.name: Gorge
packs.blurb: Narrow walls shifting from gold to steel grey as you descend, with just one way through at each turn.

packs.name: Plateau
packs.blurb: Tableland where gold ground, steel ground and narrow one way crossings all meet.

packs.name: Outback
packs.blurb: Wild country holding a bit of everything the game has crossed, together at last, on its widest stretch.

packs.name: Sinkhole
packs.blurb: The ground gives way and the daylight stays behind. Everything you learned up top comes down with you.

packs.name: Grotto
packs.blurb: Stone columns stand where the roof meets the floor. You can walk around one, never leap over it.

packs.name: Cavern
packs.blurb: A wide chamber veined with gold and steel grey, its columns standing right where a leap would help most.

packs.name: Seep
packs.blurb: Water weeps through the rock and the floor turns to mud. It lets you step away, but never spring.

packs.name: Sump
packs.blurb: The low point where everything drains: mud underfoot and crystal seams that need a second and a third look.

packs.name: Burrow
packs.blurb: Something dug here before you. Drop into one hole and come out of its twin.

packs.name: Warren
packs.blurb: Tunnel upon tunnel through gold and steel grey rock. The short way is rarely the right one.

packs.name: Seam
packs.blurb: A band of opal in the dark, guarded by columns, mud and burrows all at once.

packs.name: Lode
packs.blurb: The rich heart of the rock, veined with gold and steel grey, where every passage has its own rule for coming and going.

packs.name: Bedrock
packs.blurb: As deep as the land goes. Everything from the surface and everything from below, on the last solid floor.
